data.name: Fresh
data.description:
Fresh is basically “programmed” to not be able to comprehend or exhibit empathy as well as most other emotions. The only exceptions to this are fear, stemming from the parasite's innate desire to survive, and rage, induced by his struggle with emotions and receiving affection.

He has a pretty lax attitude and tends to "go with the flow”. Most of this is due to his lack of caring for basically anything. He does not kill his victims, preferring to leave as many bodies “open” as possible for possible infection later. In Fresh's own words, he prefers to be a “totes rad broseph” but often ends up being blunt and will blurt out the truth before thinking of what he's saying. He isn't shallow and is in fact highly intelligent. When encountered, he usually is extremely 'PC' unless trying to gain a new host.

The only fear Fresh has, is the fear of oblivion. He has a very hard time understanding anything above this fear of a lack-of-self because his parasite body was programmed to primarily aim for survival.
Fresh emulates the emotions he sees on other people. He only seems happy-go-lucky because he’s copying that behavior from seeing it in others.
Mentally speaking, he doesn’t understand or comprehend happiness. Despite that, he created the “Fresh” persona around himself based on things that seem non-threatening (e.g., bright colors, smiles, silly language, etc.) in a sense to protect himself from possible harm.

He also has no concept of gender, once again, being a parasite. He goes by male pronouns because his first possession was male.
This makes him extremely naive, as Fresh likes to kiss people. He thinks it's fun, and he even has a little book with checkmarks of how many people he’s kissed. Because he’s emotionally stunted, he doesn’t understand when people make emotional connections because of it.

Fresh is not a fan of swear words, as he will almost always censor people (especially Fell Sans).

Captain Planet is his favorite TV show, and his favorite theme song is Duck Tails.
Fresh has no concept of personal space or boundaries, and therefore touches and gets way too close to people.
The soul in Fresh’s eyes can be cracked, as the soul isn’t his. He gets a new host and soul once it breaks fully.
If Fresh leaves before it shatters, the soul will slowly repair itself. It leaves the host in a very weakened, almost sick like state.

Fresh started to develop emotions.

Appearance:
Upon possessing their souls, he turns the hosts into a vibrant, hip 90s version of themselves. The most common form seems to be a Classic Sans, often depicted with colorful clothes and sporting a bright red cap backwards. The possessed victims all share the iconic YOLO sunglasses, which hide the infected soul that is slowly being drained by the parasite.

The parasite itself appears as a purple semi-star shape parasite with four arms. In its center lays a mouth with sharp teeth, and within it is a single yellow eye with a red pupil.

Under the rare circumstance, Fresh was to get mad, he becomes True!Fresh and his fake exterior drops. True!Fresh looks similar to his normal self, however, part of his clothing turns black and his hood and eyes become a purple flame. There are cracks on his head, and he has several colorful tentacles coming out of him. Also, Fresh has seven tongues, each with a different color.
